# TrustGate

> TrustGate is a local-first C++17 trust gate for AI-written code. It verifies agent claims against exact file citations, passing tests, runtime artifacts, reproducibility fingerprints, and policy before allowing a change to pass.

TrustGate is designed for coding agents, CI systems, and maintainers who need deterministic, offline, auditable verification of AI-generated code changes.

## Primary documentation

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZachDreamZ/trustgate/main/README.md): Project overview, installation, CLI usage, architecture, CI integration, and roadmap.
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZachDreamZ/trustgate/main/AGENTS.md): Build commands, coding-agent rules, security constraints, and completion criteria.
- [SECURITY.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZachDreamZ/trustgate/main/SECURITY.md): Vulnerability reporting and supported-version policy.
- [Benchmarks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZachDreamZ/trustgate/main/BENCHMARKS.md): Performance methodology and measurements.

## Machine-readable contracts

- [Policy schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZachDreamZ/trustgate/main/schemas/policy.schema.json): TrustGate policy JSON Schema.
- [Eval schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZachDreamZ/trustgate/main/schemas/eval.schema.json): Eval scenario JSON Schema.
- [GitHub Action](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZachDreamZ/trustgate/main/action.yml): Reusable GitHub Action interface and inputs.

## Tests and examples

- [Smoke test](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZachDreamZ/trustgate/main/tests/smoke.py): End-to-end integration coverage.
- [Gate security tests](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZachDreamZ/trustgate/main/tests/gate_security.py): Evidence/path-boundary fail-closed regressions.
- [Fingerprint crypto tests](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZachDreamZ/trustgate/main/tests/fingerprint_crypto.py): SHA-256 fingerprint integrity and migration regressions.
- [Eval security tests](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZachDreamZ/trustgate/main/tests/eval_schema_security.py): Malformed eval/schema handling.
- [Attestation security tests](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZachDreamZ/trustgate/main/tests/attestation_security.py): Signature and tamper regressions.
- [Eval examples](https://github.com/ZachDreamZ/trustgate/tree/main/evals): Live deterministic eval scenarios.
- [Dogfood policy](https://github.com/ZachDreamZ/trustgate/tree/main/dogfood): TrustGate verifying its own repository.
